[USER] User expressed intrigue in the Lemon Lavender Panna Cotta but mentioned never working with lavender before.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided tips on how to use lavender in baking:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Choose the right type of lavender (English or sweet lavender).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Use dried lavender buds instead of fresh.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Use a light hand (1/4 to 1/2 teaspoon per recipe).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Infuse the flavor by steeping in hot water or milk, mixing with sugar, or adding to cream, butter, or oil.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Strain the mixture before use.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 6. Pair lavender with complementary flavors (citrus, honey, creamy ingredients).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Taste as you go.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided a simple recipe for Lemon Lavender Panna Cotta with Honey-Glazed Pistachios.  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe ingredients:  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1 cup heavy cream  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 teaspoon dried lavender buds  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup granulated sugar  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup whole milk  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/4 cup lemon juice  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - Salt to taste  
[ASSISTANT_CREATED] - 1/2 cup pistachios for honey-glazed topping
